summary: M6_2L_CODER_IMPLEMENT (CODER, implement). Implemented the approved PLAN.md item-by-item as a cumulative superset of M6.2K under 04-artifacts/impl/M6.2L/. NO plan-deltas (the plan already scoped A4 to the resolver and B4 to drop-not-raise after the plan-level adversarial review). PRECONDITION: ledger M6-P2102=RUNNING, dependency M6-P2101=PASS. THE 5 FIXES: A3 -- attribution_context.py adds attribution_id (the CTR-002 surrogate id already declared in migration 0006) as a first-class field exposed in to_public/as_stored; resolver.py derive_attribution_id() sets it deterministically (attr_+sha256(event_id)[:24], 1:1 with the row, no clock/randomness -> re-materialize idempotent). A4 -- track.py reads+validates the 4 optional M6-owned ad-hierarchy ids (campaign/adset/ad/live_session; present-but-non-string is a fail-closed SCHEMA_INVALID reject, RULE-H03), normalize.py persists them to Zone A, and resolver._entry_channels appends LIVE_ORGANIC only when NOT ads.complete so a COMPLETE ad path dominates a co-present live_session as downstream trace (FACEBOOK_AD/HIGH via the real API path, SMK-020) while an INCOMPLETE ad path + live stays MULTI_TOUCH (SMK-007, carried TESTER smoke preserved). B2 -- pack_assembler _categories/_ref_valid/_ref_binding replace raw truthiness with existence(well-formed) + (category,key)-binding + pack-wide uniqueness (optional known_refs authenticity oracle). B3 -- gap_blockers.standing_floor_ok() membership-count floor (duplicate/shadow/missing standing id FAILs), called defensively in assemble to degrade to NOT_READY. B4 -- measurement_event_store.materialize self-checks the STORED row's OWN event_code (not the caller boolean) and fail-closed DROPS non-ORDER_VERIFIED revenue/order_code WITHOUT raising (so SMK-023 'no revenue set' holds AND the two carried un-wrapped funnel smokes stay green); data_mart.verified_rows + growth.reads.verified_rows add the event_code==ORDER_VERIFIED filter (dashboard/CRM/Diamond lock; F-GROWTH-3). FINAL SUITE: 544 passed (523 carried + 21 CODER regressions), no skips; the two contested carried areas (SMK-004 funnel, SMK-007 resolver) + SMK-013 live-chain + SMK-018 set-once re-verified green. ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW (ultracode) ran at BOTH levels: plan-level (12 agents) forced two load-bearing corrections into the plan before any code (B4 drop-not-raise; A4 resolver rule); impl-level (7 agents, running the real M6.2L code) found NO CRITICAL/MAJOR and 3 CONFIRMED minor items -- (1) B2 existence was convention-shape-only in the default so a ev::{category}::FORGED ref (right category, bogus key) completed a category: FIXED by binding on (category,key), rejecting the demonstrated forgery, all tests green + a regression added; the residual (a forger reconstructing the exact canonical string still passes in the default path) is authenticity, gated on the injected known_refs oracle at the M6-OD-013 owner step and exercised by a regression; (2) SMK-023 'ROAS = 0' vs code: with no ads spend ROAS = safe_div(0, None) = None (fail-closed, RULE-003), correct-as-designed and asserted None by the CODER regression -- documented as a TESTER/operator note (assert ROAS is None, or supply mapped spend for ROAS==0); (3) A4 ad-hierarchy ids get a type-check but not the free-text payload RAW_PII tripwire and reach to_public unmasked (that export predates A4; consistent with page_id/session_id): a full phone-regex scan is deliberately NOT added (it would false-positive legitimate numeric platform ids) -- documented and deferred to M6-P2106 (SECURITY_PII) + owner (M6-OD-012), with an email-only reject noted as the false-positive-safe defense-in-depth option. Boundary intact: measure/record-only; attribution_id + ad ids recorded never acted on; no pricing/order-state/CRM-send/commission; M6-P1000/M6-P1309 stay BLOCKED and remain in the assembled pack; readiness tops at OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED. No raw secrets/PII in changed code (scanned clean); correlation/evidence ids + psid still masked on export. No self-certification; the runner gate + JUDGE decide.
